_comment: Expected results of the execution-contract acceptance (protocol v0.3 section 6.4 last paragraph; impl_plan Task 9). Written before the runs. 'calls' counts every aliased STA call (helpers included).
_note_iv: 2026-10-28 after the first run: the prediction cut_by=bytes was wrong — the measured raw output is 7635 lines x ~46 B = 352310 B; the line cap applies first and the kept 2000 lines are 91963 B < 256 KiB, so the contract's own rule gives cut_by=lines. The rule was not changed; the prediction was. Recorded in the ledger and RESULT.md.
_note_v_vi: 2026-10-28 after the first run: (v) and (vi) first hit the Tcl command-count limit (an attribution of its own, 流程限制：Tcl 命令计数上限); the samples were rewritten to reach the time limit / the 50 MiB limit within the command limit, and (v)'s expectation now describes the interpreter time limit (process completes, END marker rc=1, error lines) instead of a process kill.
_note_v_q2: 2026-10-29: (v) run twice after the Windows restart; both hit the 600 s interpreter time limit first (5065 / 5550 STA calls, <0.5 MB output, sta RSS 202-256 MB): prevalidation/acceptance/acc_v_timeout/evidence_q2.md. The first run's 734 s process time came from the executor's per-call log rescan (R6 S6, fixed); the recorded run took 610 s.
